description: External Mplus anchor for RI-LTA (t132 / phase 5b). The mood (EID) example from Muthen & Asparouhov (2022) RI-LTA paper: T=4, M=2 binary mood indicators per wave, K=2 latent statuses, STATIONARY (single time-invariant) transition matrix, MEASUREMENT-INVARIANT thresholds across time, one continuous subject-level random intercept f loaded on all item thresholds. This model maps EXACTLY onto fitRILTA's default phase-1 spec (single stationary tau, time-invariant nu, one eta ~ N(0, psiSq) with per-item loadings lambda). Mplus uses identification f@1 (factor variance fixed to 1, all loadings free); fitRILTA uses lambda_0 == 1 (free psiSq). These are equivalent reparameterizations: lambda_d_mplus = lambda_d_jstats * sqrt(psiSq_jstats), so psiSq_jstats = (lambda_0_mplus)^2 and lambda_1_jstats = lambda_1_mplus / lambda_0_mplus. The log-likelihood, AIC/BIC/SABIC, free-parameter count, entropy, transition matrix and class proportions are INVARIANT to this reparameterization (and the first four are also invariant to class label-switching and to the binary 0/1 recoding of the indicators), so they are the primary anchors.

provenance.paper: Muthen, B., & Asparouhov, T. (2022). Latent transition analysis with random intercepts (RI-LTA). Psychological Methods, 27(1), 1-16. https://doi.org/10.1037/met0000370
provenance.data_origin: Eid (2003) / Langeheine mood panel (table 1, model 2). T=4 occasions, 2 binary mood indicators per occasion, N=494 (frequency-weighted contingency table of 2^8=256 response patterns).
provenance.mplus_settings: TYPE=mixture; algorithm=integration; integration=30; starts=160 40; stscale=1. RI-LTA model: f BY u11-u42 (loadings equal across all 8 indicators within their item: p1 for first indicator of each wave, p2 for second), f@1, [f@0]. Stationarity: [c2#1-c4#1] equal, c(t+1)#1 ON c(t)#1 equal across waves. Measurement invariance: thresholds [u_t1$1] equal across waves (label 1), [u_t2$1] equal across waves (label 2), per class.

data_format: rows of [u_wave1_item1, u_wave1_item2, u_wave2_item1, u_wave2_item2, u_wave3_item1, u_wave3_item2, u_wave4_item1, u_wave4_item2, frequency]. Indicators recoded from Mplus values {1,2} to {0,1} via 2->1, 1->0 (the recoding direction is immaterial: it only flips the sign of nu and lambda, leaving logL/IC/entropy/transitions invariant). Expand each pattern by its frequency to obtain the N=494 individual-level N x T x M array (data[i][t][d]).

ri_lta.label: RI-LTA (f BY u, stationary, measurement-invariant) — Mplus Table 5 RI-LTA row

factorLoadings_mplus_fAt1.note: Mplus 'F BY' loadings under f@1. JStats lambda_1 = 6.775/2.805 = 2.4154; implied JStats psiSq = 2.805^2 = 7.868.

thresholds_mplus.note: Mplus thresholds [u$1] per class, measurement-invariant across waves. JStats nu = -threshold (sign flips with the 2->1 recoding; magnitudes are the anchor). class index ordering is Mplus-internal and may differ from JStats by label-switch.

regular_lta.label: Plain LTA (no random intercept), same data/spec — Mplus Table 5 regular-LTA row. fitRILTA reproduces this in the psiSq->0 limit (psiSqInit=1e-8, fixPsiSq, lambdaInit all-1, fixLambda).
